scope: 当前业务库。单条只读查询独立执行。

notes.jd_fks: 仅保留与岗位聚类、画像、任务和发布直接相关的表；totalRows 为原查询返回行数。
notes.inventory_csv: 全量表名和行数估计见表清单.csv。
notes.largeMapping: 通过先按目录节点 ID 聚合映射行数，再连目录表核对。

time.sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS db, VERSION() AS mysql_version, UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS checked_at_utc

start.sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS db, VERSION() AS mysql_version, UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS checked_at_utc

overview.sql: SELECT TABLE_TYPE,ENGINE,COUNT(*) AS table_count FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() GROUP BY TABLE_TYPE,ENGINE ORDER BY TABLE_TYPE,ENGINE

schema_size.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()) AS column_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()) AS index_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE='FOREIGN KEY') AS declared_foreign_keys

inventory_csv.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS table_name,TABLE_TYPE AS table_type,ENGINE AS engine,TABLE_ROWS AS estimated_rows,TABLE_COMMENT AS table_comment FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

important_sizes.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,TABLE_ROWS AS estimated_rows FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('c_industry_chain_info','c_industry_chain_position','c_industry_chain_position_typical_task','c_industry_position_ref','c_position_chain','c_company_position','c_position_type','c_position_dictionary','c_position_skill_tag','c_professional_library','c_industry_chain_full_link','t_standard_job','t_standard_job_position') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

columns.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_KEY,COLUMN_COMMENT FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('c_industry_chain_position','c_industry_chain_position_typical_task','c_industry_chain_info','c_industry_position_ref','c_position_chain','c_company_position','c_position_dictionary','c_position_skill_tag','c_industry_chain_full_link') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

rows.COLUMN_COMMENT: 岗位类型列表，以逗号分隔
是否删除;是否删除；1：是；0：否
父id列表，以英文逗号分隔
开放状态 0:删除 1:开放 2:不开放
产业岗位类型：岗位群，岗位；专业群，专业

key_indexes.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,NON_UNIQUE FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('c_industry_chain_position','c_industry_chain_position_typical_task','c_industry_position_ref','c_position_chain','c_company_position') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX

directory.sql: SELECT p.industry_chain_position_type AS node_type, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 THEN 1 END) AS active, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p.position_name),'') END) AS active_names, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 THEN p.industry_chain_id END) AS industry_ids, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 AND i.id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_industry, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.position_group_portrait),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS with_portrait, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 AND JSON_VALID(p.position_group_portrait)=1 THEN 1 END) AS valid_portrait_json, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.school_type),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS with_school_type, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 AND p.profession_library_id>0 THEN 1 END) AS with_profession_id FROM c_industry_chain_position p LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_info i ON i.id=p.industry_chain_id GROUP BY p.industry_chain_position_type ORDER BY node_type

school.sql: SELECT school_type,industry_chain_position_type AS node_type,COUNT(*) AS nodes,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(position_name),'')) AS distinct_names,COUNT(DISTINCT industry_chain_id) AS industries FROM c_industry_chain_position WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY school_type,industry_chain_position_type ORDER BY school_type,node_type

parent.sql: SELECT p.industry_chain_position_type AS node_type,CASE WHEN p.pid=0 THEN '(root)' WHEN g.id IS NULL THEN '(missing)' WHEN g.deleted<=>0 THEN g.industry_chain_position_type ELSE '(deleted parent)' END AS parent_type,COUNT(*) AS nodes,COUNT(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (p.industry_chain_id <=> g.industry_chain_id) THEN 1 END) AS cross_industry,COUNT(CASE WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (p.school_type <=> g.school_type) THEN 1 END) AS cross_school_type FROM c_industry_chain_position p LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_position g ON g.id=p.pid WHERE p.deleted=0 GROUP BY node_type,parent_type ORDER BY node_type,parent_type

orphan_by_school.sql: SELECT p.school_type,COUNT(*) AS orphan_sub_positions,COUNT(DISTINCT p.pid) AS missing_parent_ids,COUNT(DISTINCT p.industry_chain_id) AS industries,COUNT(CASE WHEN p.pid IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_parent_ids,COUNT(CASE WHEN p.pid=0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_parent_ids FROM c_industry_chain_position p LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_position parent ON parent.id=p.pid WHERE p.deleted=0 AND p.industry_chain_position_type='SUB_POSITION' AND parent.id IS NULL GROUP BY p.school_type ORDER BY p.school_type

portraits_by_school.sql: SELECT school_type,industry_chain_position_type AS node_type,COUNT(*) AS nodes,COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(position_group_portrait),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS with_portrait FROM c_industry_chain_position WHERE deleted=0 AND industry_chain_position_type IN ('POSITION_GROUP','POSITION') GROUP BY school_type,node_type ORDER BY school_type,node_type

tasks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN 1 END) AS active,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=1 THEN 1 END) AS deleted_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN industry_chain_position_id END) AS active_distinct_node_ids,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(typical_task),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS task_nonblank,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(skill_demand),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS skill_nonblank,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 AND JSON_VALID(typical_task)=1 THEN 1 END) AS task_valid_json,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 AND JSON_VALID(skill_demand)=1 THEN 1 END) AS skill_valid_json,MIN(CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN create_time END) AS earliest_create,MAX(CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN create_time END) AS latest_create,MAX(CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN update_time END) AS latest_update FROM c_industry_chain_position_typical_task

task_links.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN '(missing)' WHEN p.deleted<=>0 THEN p.industry_chain_position_type ELSE '(deleted node)' END AS node_type,COUNT(*) AS task_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT t.industry_chain_position_id) AS node_ids,COUNT(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (p.industry_chain_id <=> t.industry_chain_id) THEN 1 END) AS cross_industry FROM c_industry_chain_position_typical_task t LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_position p ON p.id=t.industry_chain_position_id WHERE t.deleted=0 GROUP BY node_type ORDER BY node_type

task_shape.sql: SELECT JSON_TYPE(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(typical_task) THEN typical_task END) AS task_json_type,JSON_TYPE(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(skill_demand) THEN skill_demand END) AS skill_json_type,COUNT(*) AS task_rows,COUNT(CASE WHEN JSON_LENGTH(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(typical_task) THEN typical_task END)=0 THEN 1 END) AS empty_tasks,COUNT(CASE WHEN JSON_LENGTH(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(skill_demand) THEN skill_demand END)=0 THEN 1 END) AS empty_skills FROM c_industry_chain_position_typical_task WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY task_json_type,skill_json_type

task_nonempty.sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN JSON_LENGTH(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(typical_task) THEN typical_task END)>0 AND JSON_LENGTH(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(skill_demand) THEN skill_demand END)>0 THEN 1 END) AS both_arrays_nonempty FROM c_industry_chain_position_typical_task WHERE deleted=0

robotics.sql: SELECT i.id AS industry_id,i.name AS industry_name,g.position_name AS group_name,p.position_name AS position_name,s.position_name AS sub_position_name,CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS group_id,CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS position_id,CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS sub_position_id,p.school_type,JSON_LENGTH(t.typical_task) AS task_items,JSON_LENGTH(t.skill_demand) AS skill_items FROM c_industry_chain_position s JOIN c_industry_chain_position p ON p.id=s.pid AND p.deleted=0 AND p.industry_chain_position_type='POSITION' JOIN c_industry_chain_position g ON g.id=p.pid AND g.deleted=0 AND g.industry_chain_position_type='POSITION_GROUP' JOIN c_industry_chain_info i ON i.id=p.industry_chain_id JOIN c_industry_chain_position_typical_task t ON t.industry_chain_position_id=s.id AND t.deleted=0 WHERE s.deleted=0 AND s.industry_chain_position_type='SUB_POSITION' AND s.industry_chain_id=15 AND s.school_type='VOCATIONAL_TECHNICAL_COLLEGE' ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 3

rows.group_name: 售后运维与技术支持岗

pure_mapping.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN '(missing)' WHEN p.deleted<=>0 THEN p.industry_chain_position_type ELSE '(deleted node)' END AS mapped_node_type,SUM(r.mapping_rows) AS mapping_rows,COUNT(*) AS mapped_node_ids FROM (SELECT industry_chain_position_id,COUNT(*) AS mapping_rows FROM c_industry_position_ref WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY industry_chain_position_id) r LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_position p ON p.id=r.industry_chain_position_id GROUP BY mapped_node_type ORDER BY mapped_node_type

valid_mapping.sql: SELECT p.school_type,COUNT(*) AS mapping_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS catalog_nodes,COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS existing_recruitment_ids,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.deleted=0 AND j.publish_state='PUBLISHING' THEN j.id END) AS publishing_ids FROM c_industry_chain_position p JOIN c_industry_position_ref r ON r.industry_chain_position_id=p.id AND r.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN c_company_position j ON j.id=r.position_id WHERE p.deleted=0 AND p.industry_chain_position_type='POSITION' GROUP BY p.school_type WITH ROLLUP

example_map.sql: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS node_id,p.industry_chain_position_type AS node_type,COUNT(r.id) AS mapping_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN j.deleted=0 AND j.publish_state='PUBLISHING' THEN j.id END) AS publishing_positions FROM c_industry_chain_position p LEFT JOIN c_industry_position_ref r ON r.industry_chain_position_id=p.id AND r.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN c_company_position j ON j.id=r.position_id WHERE p.id IN (4200000000000021352,4220018025000031274) GROUP BY p.id,p.industry_chain_position_type ORDER BY p.id

recruiting_counts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN 1 END) AS nondeleted_rows,COUNT(CASE WHEN deleted=0 AND publish_state='PUBLISHING' THEN 1 END) AS publishing_rows FROM c_company_position

exact_basics.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_industry_chain_info) AS industry_nodes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_industry_chain_info WHERE level=0) AS level_zero_industries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_position_type) AS position_type_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_position_dictionary WHERE deleted=0) AS position_dictionary_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c_position_skill_tag WHERE deleted=0) AS position_skill_tag_active

jd_counts.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_position_taxonomy_version) AS taxonomy_versions,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_position_cluster) AS clusters,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_position_cluster_membership) AS memberships,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_position_title_mapping) AS title_mappings,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_typical_work_task) AS typical_tasks,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_portrait_report) AS portrait_reports,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT position_cluster_id) FROM jd_agent_portrait_report) AS clusters_with_portraits,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_agent_publish_version) AS published_versions,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_std_clean_jd) AS standard_clean_jds,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jd_std_position) AS standard_positions

jd_std_key_columns.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,COLUMN_KEY,COLUMN_COMMENT FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND ((TABLE_NAME IN ('jd_std_position','jd_std_clean_jd') AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('id','industry_chain_position_id','standard_role_id','position_id')) OR (TABLE_NAME='jd_agent_position_cluster_membership' AND COLUMN_NAME='jd_id') OR (TABLE_NAME='jd_agent_project' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('source_table','source_config_json','source_type','data_source'))) ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME

rows.COLUMN_COMMENT: 标准岗位稳定编号（仅POSITION有）

jd_std_target.sql: SELECT s.position_type,COUNT(*) AS rows_in_std,COUNT(p.id) AS also_in_industry_catalog,COUNT(CASE WHEN p.deleted=0 THEN 1 END) AS active_in_industry_catalog,COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(s.position_group_portrait),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS with_portrait FROM jd_std_position s LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_position p ON p.id=s.id GROUP BY s.position_type

jd_std_ref.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clean_rows,COUNT(catalog.id) AS catalog_id_matches,COUNT(std.id) AS standard_id_matches,COUNT(j.id) AS recruitment_id_matches FROM jd_std_clean_jd d LEFT JOIN c_industry_chain_position catalog ON catalog.id=d.industry_chain_position_id LEFT JOIN jd_std_position std ON std.id=d.industry_chain_position_id LEFT JOIN c_company_position j ON j.id=d.position_id

jd_member_ref.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS membership_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT m.jd_id) AS distinct_jd_ids,COUNT(j.id) AS company_position_id_matches,COUNT(d.id) AS standard_clean_jd_pk_matches FROM jd_agent_position_cluster_membership m LEFT JOIN c_company_position j ON j.id=m.jd_id LEFT JOIN jd_std_clean_jd d ON d.id=m.jd_id

jd_member_overlap.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS memberships,COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jd_std_clean_jd d WHERE d.position_id=m.jd_id) THEN 1 END) AS membership_rows_sharing_a_recruitment_id FROM jd_agent_position_cluster_membership m

jd_project_sources.sql: SELECT source_table,COUNT(*) AS projects FROM jd_agent_project GROUP BY source_table ORDER BY projects DESC

shared_chain_fks.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (TABLE_NAME IN ('c_industry_chain_info','c_industry_chain_position','c_industry_chain_position_typical_task','c_industry_position_ref','c_position_chain','c_company_position','jd_std_position','jd_std_clean_jd') OR REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IN ('c_industry_chain_info','c_industry_chain_position','c_industry_chain_position_typical_task','c_industry_position_ref','c_position_chain','c_company_position','jd_std_position','jd_std_clean_jd')) ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME

jd_fks.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (LEFT(TABLE_NAME,9)='jd_agent_' OR LEFT(TABLE_NAME,7)='jd_std_' OR LEFT(REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,9)='jd_agent_' OR LEFT(REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,7)='jd_std_' OR TABLE_NAME IN ('c_industry_chain_position_typical_task','c_industry_chain_position','c_industry_position_ref')) ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME
